bank.q: What does the 'F' stand for in the FINER research topic feasibility criteria?
bank.explanation: FINER stands for Feasible, Interesting, Novel, Ethical, and Relevant.

bank.q: Which of the following is considered an empirically bounded thesis topic?
options: Impact of Transformational Leadership on Faculty Job Satisfaction in Public Universities of South Punjab (2025)
How Management Works in Modern Organizations
bank.explanation: A bounded topic specifies the exact construct, target population, organizational context, and geographic region.

bank.q: A research proposal submitted to the Departmental Board of Studies should describe data collection in the past tense.
bank.explanation: False. Proposals outline future investigations and must be written in the future tense ('Data will be collected').

bank.q: What is the recommended overall similarity threshold set by the HEC Pakistan Plagiarism Policy 2020?
options: No higher than 19% overall, with no single source exceeding 5%
No higher than 25% overall, with no single source exceeding 10%
bank.explanation: The official HEC Pakistan 2020 policy allows a maximum similarity index of 19% overall, with single-source similarity capped at 5%.

bank.q: What constitutes an authentic research gap in academic literature?
options: A topic that no one in the world has ever mentioned before
A documented empirical or conceptual contradiction/omission in high-impact peer-reviewed literature
A personal opinion that has not been proven on social media
A topic chosen solely because data is easy to download
bank.explanation: An authentic research gap is identified through systematic analysis of peer-reviewed literature where findings conflict, boundary conditions remain untested, or populations are empirically omitted.
